channel.title: IndieHOT — Indie Game Hot Topics
channel.description: IndieHOT collects indie game news from a set of public sources every day and scores it by rules: engines & tools, publishing & marketing, devlogs, industry & funding, events, reviews & postmortems. Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are shown — no full text is republished.

item.title: Say cheese! Recreating an iconic 2D art style with UE5 in Bluey's Happy Snaps
item.description: The Gameloft Brisbane team shares how Unreal Engine 5 animation tools helped translate the hit kids' TV show Bluey's iconic 2D world into a 3D game.

item.title: Keep Unreal Engine 5 Projects Clean with This Optimization Toolkit
item.description: Leartes Studios' editor extension scores project health, finds unused assets and maps dependencies, helping Unreal Engine 5 developers keep their projects tidy.

item.title: The Unity CLI 1.0 is here!
item.description: Unity's command-line tool is out of beta, letting developers connect Claude Code and other AI coding assistants to a Unity project and automate builds and tests from the terminal.

item.title: Gyro Weekly: Phantom Blade Zero Takes Silver at Golden Joystick, Jensen Huang's Resignation May Ripple Through Gaming
item.description: This week's industry roundup covers Phantom Blade Zero's Golden Joystick result, how Jensen Huang's resignation could affect gaming GPUs, and a new Steam breakout — a quick scan for developers tracking overseas trends.

item.title: Football Manager Fought Through Two Rough Years and Is Finally Back on Track
item.description: After switching to Unity, a cancelled FM25 and a rocky FM26, a conversation with the FM27 team on how the series is finding its footing again.

item.title: PixiJS Moves Into 3D – PixiJS 3D
item.description: PixiJS, the popular 2D WebGL and WebGPU framework, has moved into 3D, opening it up to developers using engines like GDevelop and RPG Maker.

item.title: NO AI Looking for a small team to help develop an existing Unreal Engine game
item.description: An indie developer who has spent about a year on a third-person action roguelite in Unreal Engine is looking for a small team to help take the game to its next stage.

item.title: Monster Hunter Outlanders passes $10.2 million in IAP revenue in two weeks
item.description: The Monster Hunter mobile spin-off passed $10.2 million in in-app purchase revenue in just over two weeks — a handy benchmark for indie developers weighing mobile monetization.

item.title: GDC 2026 Report: 40% of Developers Use AI, 34% Were Laid Off in the Past Two Years
item.description: GDC's State of the Game Industry report finds AI in 40% of developers' daily work while a third faced layoffs in two years — sobering context for indies.

item.title: MAGICKNESS Dev Log #04: Building a 2D World Lobby Inside an Unreal Engine 5 MMORPG
item.description: This dev log covers connecting a 2D narrative environment to a multiplayer fantasy simulation, debugging replication issues, and bringing story development into a playable MMORPG demo.

item.title: PC Engine CD BIOS Devlog: Three Experimental Services in One Boot Path, 18 DEV Entries
item.description: The open-source PC Engine CD BIOS replacement moves from observing calls to actually running three experimental services, with the dev ROM now implementing 18 of 81 candidate entry points.

item.title: Can You Compare GPU Counter Data Across Mali, Adreno, and PowerVR Devices?
item.description: Each vendor defines GPU load differently, so the same counter reading means different things on different chips — compare a device against its own past runs, not against another phone.

item.title: Publish a Godot Game on Google Play: Closed Testing Guide
item.description: A step-by-step guide to exporting a signed AAB from Godot and shipping it through Play Console closed testing, covering the full flow for new personal developer accounts.

item.title: Why Tencent Calls AI a "Life-or-Death" Matter: The Strategic Anxiety and Ambition Behind an Internal Memo
item.description: Tencent's 28th-anniversary management notes frame the AI shift as a matter of survival and clarify that "half defend, half attack" is not layoffs — indie developers can read how a giant is reorganizing for the AI era.

item.title: After $200M in Two Months, Harry Potter: Magic Awakened Announces Shutdown
item.description: With its license agreement expiring, Harry Potter: Magic Awakened will stop top-ups and delist on December 21, 2026, and shut down its servers on March 3, 2027 — a reminder of the lifecycle risks behind licensed-IP games.

item.title: Best AI GIF Generators with Transparent Background (2026 Engineering Comparison)
item.description: Most AI animation tools output opaque rectangular video that still needs background removal; this comparison tests which generators produce transparent-background GIFs directly, saving creators the extra cleanup step.

item.title: The GTA VI Launch Engineering
item.description: Twenty-five million players pulling 150GB at roughly the same time is an extraordinary launch-day load; this technical walkthrough looks at the engineering behind surviving that download surge.

item.title: GDC survey: 70% of mobile studio workers use generative AI
item.description: A GDC survey of more than 2,600 industry professionals across 69 countries finds 70% of workers at mobile-only studios use generative AI, well above the industry average.

item.title: Gridwright: 31 browser tools for 2D game art + matching pixel-art packs
item.description: Built to fix programmer art and mismatched asset packs, Gridwright packs 31 2D game-art tools, including a sprite sheet maker, into the browser, with matching pixel-art packs to go with them.

item.title: Unity Offers Indie Developers $50K Grants Through New Fellowship Program
item.description: Unity’s new Fellowship program offers indie developers $50K grants with no equity or repayment — worth a look for eligible teams.
